# Routing Demo Requirements Checklist: Cost vs Quality

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the 100-request portfolio routing demo: live/recorded evidence, cheaper-first reuse, baseline savings, quality metrics, and blocked-on-down honesty. Not an implementation test plan.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. Intended for the author before `/speckit-tasks` and for peers on spec/PR review.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are exactly 100 heterogeneous requests required for a completed demo run? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Are per-request chosen route and human-readable rationale both required in output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, US1]
- [x] CHK003 Are aggregate routed cost, named baseline cost, and savings (absolute + percentage) all required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Is invented fixture-catalog savings forbidden as the demo proof, with live or labeled recorded evidence required instead? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, US3]
- [x] CHK005 Are latency and success rate required as quality metrics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 Is reuse of existing live-routing cheaper-first mandated (no competing selection policy)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, US2]
- [x] CHK007 Are Spec 272 Phase 3 and ADK explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is “blocked” defined so unreachable live catalog cannot be reported as a completed live savings story? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, US3]
- [x] CHK009 Is the expensive baseline defined as the costliest still-qualified identity per request? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications Q3]
- [x] CHK010 Is recorded replay distinguishable from live (explicit option + `mode=recorded` + capture time)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Q5, US3]
- [x] CHK011 Is the <60s wall-clock target scoped to healthy live-catalog runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, SC-002]
- [x] CHK012 Is “heterogeneous” defined as a fixed mix of simple and complex request classes? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications Q4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do FR-004, US3, and SC-003/SC-004 agree that fixture invention cannot satisfy the demo? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK014 Does cheaper-first (FR-008/US2) remain consistent with baseline being costliest qualified (not a second policy)? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK015 Are ownership paths (`verdict/routing_demo.py`, docs/benchmarks, tests) consistent with not touching 272 P3 files? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications Q1, FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 Does secret-omission apply equally to live and recorded outputs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, US3 AC3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can SC-001 (reviewer understands savings without source) be scored from demo output alone? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK018 Can SC-002 (100 requests, <60s) be measured objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK019 Can SC-003 (numbers match underlying live/recorded evidence) be audited? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 Can SC-004 (blocked when down, no fabricated chart) fail closed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK021 Can SC-005 (no paid while cheaper kept) be checked from decisions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are partial execute failures required to reduce success rate rather than invent successes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, research R4]
- [x] CHK024 Are empty/unhealthy catalog outcomes specified as blocked for live savings? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Is duration pressure forbidden as a reason to invent fixture math? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
